hotel_name: Qotel Comfort Golden Saffron Punjabi Bagh

positive_snippets: I stayed at this hotel for 10 days and my experience was good. Everything was well managed and comfortable. Specially The security guard, Mr. Ranjeet Yadav, was a very kind and helpful person. He was always polite and supportive. I really appreciate his behavior and service. Thank you!”

We stayed at Golden Saffron Hotel during my mother’s treatment at CK Birla Hospital, and the experience was excellent. The staff was kind, attentive, and genuinely supportive throughout our stay. The room service team went beyond regular hotel duties and helped care for my mother with great sensitivity and patience. Truly grateful for their warmth and professionalism.

I recently stayed at this hotel, and my overall experience was genuinely memorable. From the moment I arrived, the check-in process was smooth and efficient. The staff at the reception were warm, attentive, and made sure I felt welcomed right away. They guided me with all the necessary information about the property, nearby attractions, and services available during the stay.
negative_snippets:

Has small small flaus which addressed to at some level especially by Aditya (a trianee) @ the hotel.
